after_daemon_death.note: With the daemon dead the container shim lingers (no scientific process under it) until a daemon returns; the wrapper reports the daemon unavailable and writes no confirmation. The audit removed its own leftover shim by PID afterwards.

scenario: dockerd SIGKILLed while Core runs (containerd and shim survive)
